nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 1$ be a natural number. Morozov's Wilson quotient sum $Z(n)$ is an integer; moreover $Z(n) \equiv 1 \pmod{n}$ if $n$ is neither $1$ nor prime, and $Z(n) \equiv -1 \pmod{n}$ if $n = 1$ or $n$ is prime.
nodes.title: The Wilson quotient sum Z(n) modulo n

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n \ge 1$, Morozov's Wilson quotient sum $Z(2n - 1)$ is an integer, and it is divisible by $n$ if and only if $n = 1$ or $n$ is prime.
nodes.title: A primality criterion from the Wilson quotient sum Z(2n − 1)

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n \ge 1$, Morozov's Wilson quotient sum $Z(n)$ is an integer.
nodes.title: The Wilson quotient sum is an integer

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 1$ be a natural number. Morozov's sign-adjusted Wilson quotient sum $Z^+(2n)$ is an integer; it satisfies $Z^+(2n) \equiv 0 \pmod{2n}$ if $n = 2$ or $n$ is neither $1$ nor prime, and $Z^+(2n) \equiv n + 1 \pmod{2n}$ if $n$ is an odd prime.
nodes.title: The sign-adjusted Wilson quotient sum Z⁺(2n) modulo 2n

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n \ge 1$, Morozov's sign-adjusted Wilson quotient sum $Z^+(n)$ is a natural number if and only if $n$ is even, $n = 1$, or $n$ is prime.
nodes.title: When the sign-adjusted Wilson quotient sum is a natural number

nodes.summary: For every prime $p$, the Wilson quotient $W(p)$ of $p$ satisfies $(p-1)! = p \, W(p) - 1$ in $\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Factorial form of the Wilson quotient identity

nodes.summary: For every prime $p$, the Wilson quotient $W(p)$ of $p$ satisfies $p \, W(p) = (p-1)! + 1$ in $\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Exactness of the Wilson quotient

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 1$ and $k < n$ be natural numbers. Then $(-1)^k \, k! \, (n - k - 1)! \equiv -1 \pmod{n}$ if and only if $n = 1$ or $n$ is prime.
nodes.title: A generalized Wilson criterion for primality

nodes.summary: For a natural number $p$, the Wilson quotient is the integer $W(p) = \lfloor ((p-1)! + 1) / p \rfloor$ for $p \ge 1$, and $W(0) = 0$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
